description: Sends a booking request to the owner on the guest's behalf, priced by the same engine as get_quote. This is request to book: the owner confirms by email to the guest with a payment link, and nothing is charged now. Call it ONLY after the guest has seen the quote and explicitly asked you to send the request, and set guestApproved to true to confirm that. Every call reaches a real person: never send tests, duplicates or requests the guest has not approved. Errors: as get_quote, plus MISSING_CONTACT and GUEST_APPROVAL_REQUIRED. A request holds nothing. Dates are reserved when the deposit or full payment clears. Cancellation: full refund when cancelled 30 or more days before arrival; inside 30 days the stay is not refundable, except that returning direct guests can cancel anytime and a hurricane warning or mandatory evacuation order for Manatee County covering the stay dates means a full refund whenever cancelled.

code.description: Discount code, only if the guest already has one

dog.description: True if the guest brings a dog (adds the pet fee). The REST endpoint calls this parameter pets; this server accepts pets as an alias.

email.description: Guest's email; the owner replies here with the payment link

guestApproved.description: Must be true: the guest saw this quote and asked you to send the request

notes.description: Anything the guest wants the owner to know (optional)

property.description: happy-island-cottage = Happy Island Cottage, sleeps 6; happy-turtle-a = Happy Turtle A, sleeps 5; happy-turtle-b = Happy Turtle B, sleeps 4

name: request_booking
title: Send a booking request
